text.title: Django Services Layer Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example applying the methodology to a representative input. Output matches the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml.

section.title: Trace
section.paragraph: View POST /orders/ accepts payload, creates Order + OrderLine + AuditLog, then sends confirmation email. Extract into order_create(*, user_id: int, items: list[dict], notes: str | None = None) -> Order living in apps.orders.services — one module for the orders aggregate, not one per caller. The service takes primitives, not the request, so admin and the Celery task can call the same function. Wrap in @transaction.atomic because 3 writes. Replace send_email.delay(order.id) with transaction.on_commit(lambda: send_email.delay(order.id)). View becomes a 4-line dispatch. Run import-linter: services/ has no django.http import (http_imports = 0) and no caller mutates the ORM directly (orm_outside_services = 0).
